# CLI reference

lakreet-swarm — render many videos from one EffectCraft template + a data file

## Commands

| Command   | Purpose                                             |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `render`  | Render a batch of videos                            |
| `check`   | Validate template + data without rendering          |
| `inspect` | Show template controls, media, and composition info |
| `init`    | Generate a starter CSV from a template              |
| `preview` | Quick PNG frame per row (visual check)              |
| `doctor`  | Environment diagnostics                             |

## Global options

| Option                  | Description                                |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `--cli <path>`          | Path to effectcraft-cli                    |
| `--config <file>`       | Config file (default: lakreet.config.json) |
| `--json`                | Machine-readable NDJSON output             |
| `--quiet` / `--verbose` | Output verbosity                           |
| `--no-color`            | Disable colour                             |
| `-h, --help`            | Show help                                  |
| `-v, --version`         | Show version                               |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning                   |
| ---- | ------------------------- |
| 0    | OK                        |
| 1    | Render failed             |
| 2    | Usage error               |
| 3    | Invalid data              |
| 4    | effectcraft-cli not found |
| 5    | Template unreadable       |
| 130  | Interrupted (Ctrl+C)      |

See individual command pages for detailed options and examples.
